title: Training Questions and Answers: The Part of Held Leak Charges That Stays Payable
content:
# The Part of Held Charges That Stays Payable — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** On a Utility Services Program account, a part of the held charges stays payable:

- when the dispute carries a leak repair date and **at least 6** actual water reads other than the read of the disputed period are dated fewer than seven whole months before the payment date, the payable part is the held charges times the usual water usage for the undisputed balance divided by the disputed line's usage, rounded half up to the cent;
- when the dispute carries a leak repair date and **fewer than 6** such reads exist, the payable part is the program's monthly fixed water service charge plus, when the sewer line is held with it, the monthly fixed sewer service charge;
- in every other situation no part of the held charges is payable.

The **usual water usage for the undisputed balance** is the usage of the actual water reads dated fewer than seven whole months before the payment date less the usage billed on the disputed line (the read of the disputed period), divided by the number of those reads less one, rounded to 3 decimals; each sum of recorded water usage is taken to 2 decimals.

When a part of the held charges stays payable, the undisputed balance is the open balance less the held charges plus that part, rounded half up to the cent.

## Questions answered

**Which reads are counted toward the 6?** Actual water reads dated fewer than seven whole months before the payment date, not counting the read of the disputed period. Seven such actual reads in the window, the disputed one among them, count as 6.

**Does a dispute without a leak repair date leave anything payable?** No; no part of the held charges is payable.

## Worked case (hypothetical account)

Seven actual water reads in the window total 26.30 thousand gallons, one of them the disputed period's 12.30; held charges are $226.82 on a disputed usage of 12.300.

- Usual usage: 26.30 less 12.30 is 14.00, divided by 6 is 2.333.
- Payable part: $226.82 times 2.333 divided by 12.300 is $43.02.

With only five other actual reads, the payable part is the water service charge plus the sewer service charge, since the sewer line is held.
